title: The Horizon of Sector Nine
author: Ivo Sandoval
blurb: Juniper Yarrow, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
